Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 3-J at 3239 W. Division St
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                Committee on Zoning, Landmarks, and Building Standards




                                      ORDINANCE



B E IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be amended by changing all of the B1-2,
Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 3-J in
the area bound by:

      West Division Street; a line 85.44 feet east of and parallel to the alley next east of and
      parallel to North Spaulding Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to West Division
      Street; and a line 115.66 feet east of and parallel to the alley next east of and parallel to
      North Spaulding Avenue,

      to those of a B l - 1 , Neighborhood Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                            Roberto Maldonado
                                                            Alderman, 26"^ Ward




Common Address:
3239 W. Division Street
